evals.prompt: Our deploy sends SIGTERM to a service with an in-memory job queue. Implement graceful shutdown so accepted jobs finish, but the container has a 30-second termination grace period.
evals.expected_output: Inspects framework/lifecycle, stops admission and readiness before draining, bounds the drain below the hard timeout, closes workers/clients in order, and explicitly states remaining volatile work may be lost if the deadline expires.

evals.prompt: The HTTP server shuts down cleanly but messages still arrive while the worker process exits. What should the shutdown flow do?
evals.expected_output: Separates HTTP listener lifecycle from consumer intake; pauses/stops broker consumption, drains owned in-flight work, handles leases/acks safely, and tests signal-time races and timeout recovery.
